evidence: Loads the configured value from the global object at 0x7004650000+0x998, reads its 32-bit field at +0xC, and tail-calls validate_selector_and_lookup_code with that value. Caller build_contextual_attribute_report supplies selector IDs 1 and 0 and stores each result. decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0093.c:49924-49929; decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0119.c:50043-50051.

The function checks that the pointer at object+0x20 is non-null and its fields at +0x218/+0x220 match, then requires attribute_context_status_value_get(object, 0x13) to equal 4 before invoking an opaque helper with the nested object and arguments 3, 255. Caller dispatch_context_status_attribute_event establishes an event-dispatch context but does not resolve the helper's action. decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0035.c:40587-40609; decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0053.c:2876-2880.

Calls calculate_contextual_status_dependent_value twice with the same three inputs and differing x7 flag values (1, then 1 & ~input3), then returns the first result minus the second. Caller uses it in a numeric computation and compares its result against 0x64. decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0006.c:33289-33311; decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0014.c:19241-19245.

For input values <=0x5E, checks attribute_context_status_is_2_or_3, computes an indexed record address using a 0x18-byte stride, calls an opaque helper with pointers into that record, then writes bytes at offsets 0x13 and 0x14. Its caller reads the record afterward, but the record and helper semantics are not identified well enough to name this operation. decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0056.c:30960-30987; decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0049.c:42582-42586.

Runs an opaque predicate, obtains another status value and checks it against 4 and 6, then conditionally calls an opaque helper with two global-backed pointers. The caller ignores the result and returns zero, which does not establish the operation's semantic purpose. decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0075.c:29628-29654; decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0083.c:54277-54281.
